investigations.name: og-autocatalysis-a2
investigations.title: Endogenous Autocatalysis: Does a Self-Amplifying Cycle Form?
investigations.objective: Can vent-fed chemistry spontaneously form a balanced, self-amplifying autocatalytic cycle that beats a matched null with equal input fluxes — across the two representable routes (rule-generated linear-C6 formose chemistry, and the curated branched reductive-TCA cycle) — or does it only fix carbon (persistence, A1) without self-amplifying (A2)?
investigations.claim: Both tested routes fail under modeled vent conditions — endogenous self-amplifying autocatalysis is refuted across both representable routes, each against its own matched null. This is a limitation of the modeled vent redox environment, NOT a universal impossibility (see the beyond-vent counterfactual below). The linear-C6 formose arm (og-29) is thermodynamically refuted and seed-independent: the canonical doubling step (r409, 2 glycolaldehyde <-> threose) runs toward condensation (dG0 -16.4 kJ/mol) at vent feeds, so the splitting direction carries no net flux (gain 0, motifs 0 across x1-x50) and production is feed-driven, not self-amplified. The branched reductive-TCA arm (og-rtca) is autocatalytic in TOPOLOGY (its net turn doubles oxaloacetate with no coefficient-2 reaction, so a coefficient detector reads 0 by construction and a coefficient-free functional discriminator is required), yet washes out under vent H2 because the closing reductive carboxylations (succinate->a-ketoglutarate +18, acetyl->pyruvate +31 kJ/mol) run uphill and too slow against washout — the same reason the biological cycle uses ferredoxin, not H2. In a LABELLED beyond-vent counterfactual (lower carboxylation barrier + lower dilution) the same rTCA topology meets the self-amplification bar and is topology-specific (the matched null stays off), so the vent negative is a redox-environment limitation, not a defect of the cycle's wiring. The counterfactual is explicitly not a vent claim. Headline verdict is bounded by the honest negative of both arms: refuted. Every matched null and every arm verdict is preserved.
baseline_names: Endogenous autocatalysis — formose keystone arm (og-29, canonical)
Reductive-TCA autocatalysis (vent-fed) — branched-v2 arm (og-rtca)
Reductive-TCA degree-preserving matched null (equal feeds) — og-rtca matched null

investigations.name: og-carbon-fixation
investigations.title: Carbon Fixation: Does H2 Reduce CO2 at the Vent?
investigations.objective: Does H2-driven CO2 reduction over Fe/Ni/S catalysts fix carbon and reproduce lab yield benchmarks at the vent — and can the model classes agree on which limitation stops it?
investigations.claim: H2-driven CO2 reduction fixes carbon at the vent. Over Fe/Ni/S catalysts the model reproduces the Preiner-2020 yield hierarchy (formate ~200 mM >> acetate ~100 uM >> pyruvate ~10 uM) and sustains net organic-carbon flux in a bounded pH-gradient x dissolved-H2 region; formate collapses to <1 mM in every no-gradient / no-H2 / no-catalyst control, and carbon fixation spends the proton gradient (~2 H+/carbon, chemiosmotic backpressure) (og-01, canonical, supported). Under explicit electrochemistry the vent cell is activation (catalyst) limited where the wall conducts and its current sits in the Altair-2025 window, but the two model classes agree on the dominant-limitation label on only 47% of the favorable region (below the pre-registered 80% gate), so the limitation attribution is structure-sensitive and og-01-cal-electrochemistry is refuted on that agreement question (og-01-cal, refuted; og-01-cal-dx planned to diagnose). Consolidated headline: supported — carbon fixation works and reproduces lab benchmarks; the mechanistic attribution of its rate-limiting step is not yet model-class-robust. Every matched null and arm verdict kept, including the refutation.
baseline_names: Hydrothermal carbon fixation — favorable, canonical (og-01)
No-gradient / no-H2 / no-catalyst matched null (og-01) — formate collapses <1 mM
Explicit electrochemical interface — Butler-Volmer + empirical classes (og-01-cal arm, refuted)

investigations.name: og-ecology
investigations.title: Protocell Ecology: Does Community Function Precede the Cell?
investigations.objective: Is protocell-era chemistry ecological before it is cellular — does a cross-feeding community out-produce the best single lineage (margin causally cross-feeding), does community function precede cell completeness and vanish without exchange — each against its own matched null with input fluxes held equal?
investigations.claim: Protocell-era chemistry is ecological before it is cellular. A stochastic cross-feeding community out-produces the best single lineage with the margin causally attributable to cross-feeding and coexistence stabilized (not assumed), though the community is NOT more robust than monoculture and low-count stochasticity materially changes outcomes (og-36, qualified); a connected metacommunity beats an isolated control with cross-feeding robustness and closed ledgers (og-07, supported); and real metabolite exchange makes community function PRECEDE cell completeness and VANISH without exchange, segregated placement keeping function (og-07-alt, supported). Headline verdict qualified; every matched null and every arm verdict preserved.
baseline_names: Stochastic protocell ecology (community vs best single, matched null) — canonical arm (og-36)
Cross-feeding metacommunity (connected vs isolated) — og-07 arm
Real metabolite-exchange community (function before cell completeness) — og-07-alt arm

investigations.name: og-energetics
investigations.title: Proto-Energetics: Can a System Capture and Couple Free Energy?
investigations.objective: Can a primitive chemical system capture geochemical free energy, internalize it under selection, and couple a specified carrier to perform endergonic work — and does any of it improve total throughput, or only persistence/robustness — each tested against a matched null with a closing ledger?
investigations.claim: Across fidelities, a protocell's energetics buy robustness/persistence, not raw throughput. A primitive carrier captures geochemical free energy into a transferable store with a closing ledger (proto-energetics arm, supported); a compartment internalizes electrochemical work under selection and pays for it within a Sojo-bounded survival region (internalization arm, supported); which coupling chemistry pays is structure-sensitive and membrane-leak-dependent (5-class alt arm, supported, classes agree ~46%); and a specified thioester carrier does useful work through a gradient dip where gradient-only starves but does NOT improve total useful work (sharpened Gate-E arm, og-35, qualified). The consolidated headline is bounded by that sharpest arm: qualified, dip-persistence not throughput. Every matched null and every arm verdict is preserved.
baseline_names: Chemical energy coupling (thioester carrier) — canonical headline arm (og-35)
Gradient-only null (no carrier store, equal drive/load) — og-35 matched null
Proto-energetics carrier capture (og-energy-proto arm)
Bioenergetic internalization under selection (og-05 arm)
Internalization-threshold 5-class sweep (og-energy-alt arm)

investigations.name: og-evolvability
investigations.title: Evolvability and Selection: Is an Inherited Difference Selectable?
investigations.objective: Does a daughter-inherited chemical difference produce a reproducible, selectable fitness difference, and does the population shift under selection rather than drift?
investigations.claim: A daughter-inherited chemical difference produces a reproducible, selectable fitness difference and the population shifts under selection rather than drifting: parent-offspring fitness correlation +0.949 vs a no-inheritance control, population shift +0.551 vs drift -0.004, against a matched no-inheritance null (og-34, canonical). Qualified — evolvability demonstrated on the modeled trait space; open-ended chemical novelty beyond that space is not.
baseline_names: Chemical heredity & selection — inheritance arm (canonical, og-34)
No-inheritance matched null (og-34)

investigations.name: og-evolvable-lineages
investigations.title: Evolvable Lineages: Can a Granted Individual Evolve?
investigations.objective: Do mechanically defensible daughters carry heritable chemical variation that produces a multi-generation, open-ended evolutionary response - beyond a fixed trait space?
investigations.claim: Given a granted individual, stochastic partition + variation produce real heritable, selectable adaptation that shifts the population strongly above both matched nulls (no-inheritance and shared-feed) and re-tracks a changed environment - but it is bounded fixed-trait selection (heritable variance declines as it converges; the trait space is a fixed scalar), not open-ended novelty. Combined with og-self-maintaining-individual: the individuality bottleneck is the binding one; given an individual, evolvability works but is bounded. Qualified.
baseline_names: Evolvable lineages — canonical (granted individual, grounded selection, static environment)
No-inheritance null (daughters reset to common composition)
Shared-feed null (flat fitness landscape, no fitness differential)

investigations.name: og-heredity
investigations.title: Chemical Inheritance: Can a Chemical Difference Be Transmitted?
investigations.objective: Can a protocell transmit a heritable chemical difference to its daughters at a feasible cost, without presuming a long high-fidelity RNA template?
investigations.claim: A protocell transmits a heritable chemical difference to its daughters at a feasible cost, and heredity need not presume a long high-fidelity RNA template: competing modules graded head-to-head show inheritance beats a non-heritable control and compositional/hybrid heredity escapes the Eigen length catastrophe (og-06), and an information-per-cost frontier ranks six mechanisms by heritable bits per joule with attachment conditional on budget (og-06-alt). Supported. Selectability is tested separately in og-evolvability.
baseline_names: Competing inheritance modules (og-06 arm)
Information-per-cost frontier, six mechanisms (og-06-alt arm)

investigations.name: og-independence
investigations.title: Independence from the Vent: Can a Lineage Escape Its Cradle?
investigations.objective: How independent of its geological cradle can a vent-born protocell lineage become — what minimum innovation set lets it persist as external support is withdrawn, which supports can it internalize vs which remain hard dependencies, and is any apparent independence causally attributable to a specific innovation against a matched ablation with input fluxes held equal?
investigations.claim: A vent-born protocell lineage reaches GRADED, attributed independence, not an all-or-nothing (and not a free) escape. og-08 withdrew gradient + mineral + feed JOINTLY and found a coordinated innovation set {internal pump, importer, heredity} where any single removal collapses persistence — but joint relaxation cannot attribute which innovation rescues which support, so that general minimal-sufficiency reading is rescoped to a reduced, model-specific hypothesis (supported within its one coarse model). og-08-alt-robust then tests the set ACROSS model structures on a 2³ subset lattice and resolves it driver-specifically: the {pump, importer, heredity} triple is advantageous but NOT a jointly-necessary irreducible unit — only pump+heredity interact positively, the active importer is required by no driver (a net cost under a leaky membrane), and the hard dependency is the geological gradient (the full set rescues its withdrawal in only ~4.2% of structures), while mineral (0.958) and feed (0.75) are freely/borderline survivable needing no specific innovation. og-37's one-at-a-time withdrawal agrees: the gradient is the budget-sensitive hard dependency (pump-internalization flips below pump efficiency ~0.7, grounded in the energy arm's persistence-not-throughput surplus), while mineral and feed need no innovation. Because the feed is LUMPED (H2+CO2+organics) and the innovations are coarse budget abstractions, this is an affordability/attribution profile, not a demonstrated escape — headline verdict qualified. Every matched null and every arm verdict is preserved explicitly.
baseline_names: Progressive independence (all-at-once, full innovation set) — canonical headline arm (og-37)
One-at-a-time per-channel withdrawal (the attribution novelty) — og-37
Escape from the vent (joint all-at-once relaxation) — og-08 foundation arm
Integrated autonomy — minimum-sufficient set across structures (honest negative) — og-08-alt-robust

investigations.name: og-network-persistence
investigations.title: Network Persistence: Does the Carbon-Fixing Network Sustain Itself?
investigations.objective: Under continuous vent-realistic feed and washout, does the prebiotic carbon-fixing network persist and sustain net carbon throughput as a connected system — and does it do so by endogenous autocatalytic amplification or merely by sustained driven flux — each arm tested against a matched null with a closing ledger?
investigations.claim: Across fidelities the prebiotic carbon-fixing network persists — it sustains net carbon throughput as a connected system under vent-realistic feed + washout (og-02, canonical, supported) — but its persistence is driven, not autocatalytic self-amplification. Graded by a common detector, og-02's curated rTCA motif is imposed and element-unbalanced (the apparent gain an artifact); the rule-generated open universe (121 species, 413 balanced reactions) sustains a 14-species persistent network with NO autocatalytic motif at the vent feed, because every C-C-forming route is uphill, and the single motif that emerges (formose) requires an exogenous formaldehyde feed the vent chemistry does not make (og-02-alt, supported, p=0.04 vs 24 matched nulls). A versioned, provenance-tracked reaction atlas with a zero-leakage write gate supplies the balanced, confidence-tiered reactions both arms draw on (og-28, supported). Consolidated headline: supported — the network persists; endogenous autocatalysis is refuted at vent feed and tracked as the og-autocatalysis line. Every matched null and arm verdict kept.
baseline_names: Curated minimal carbon-fixing network — canonical (og-02)
No-CO2-feed matched null (og-02) — network collapses without the carbon source
Rule-generated open chemical universe at the vent posterior (og-02-alt arm)
Provenance-gated reaction atlas (og-28 arm)

investigations.name: og-network-rescue
investigations.title: Network Rescue: Does Pore Concentration Ignite the Reaction Network?
investigations.objective: Does pore concentration ignite the carbon-fixing reaction network where a matched well-mixed, nonconcentrating control does not?
investigations.claim: At identical vent-posterior feeds held equal, a concentrating mineral pore ignites the carbon-fixing network (net carbon flux +4.5e-4, 17 persistent species; confirmed on the six-carbon network) while a matched well-mixed, nonconcentrating control stays dead — spatial concentration is the only difference, so the pore causes the productive flux (og-30, canonical). Supported.
baseline_names: Spatially integrated protometabolism in a concentrating pore — canonical (og-30)
Matched well-mixed, non-concentrating null (og-30) — stays dark at equal feed

investigations.name: og-nutrient-bottlenecks
investigations.title: Nutrient Bottlenecks: Are Nitrogen and Phosphorus Available with Carbon?
investigations.objective: Do the two non-carbon nutrient bottlenecks clear at the vent — does reduced nitrogen (ammonium) keep pace with carbon fixation, and does reactive phosphorus co-concentrate with carbon rather than precipitate — each against its own matched null with input fluxes held equal?
investigations.claim: Each non-carbon nutrient bottleneck clears individually: ammonium is produced and sustained, keeping pace with carbon fixation (a viable C:N) while the feature-ablation null produces none and nitrogen mass is conserved (nitrogen arm, supported); reactive phosphorus is available and co-concentrates with carbon in the pore while an open-pore no-enrichment control shows none and P mass is conserved (phosphorus arm, supported). Qualified overall: these are separate concentration successes, not a joint C/N/P feasibility — whether C, N and P are available together in compatible chemical forms and the same physical regime is the harder, open bar carried by og-precursor-pool and og-operating-window. Every matched null and arm verdict preserved.
baseline_names: Reduced-nitrogen reactor (ammonium, C:N balance) — canonical arm (og-res-nitrogen)
Phosphorus availability (reactive-P co-concentration) — og-res-phosphorus arm

investigations.name: og-operating-window
investigations.title: Operating Window: Can Pore and Membrane Concentration Rescue the Pool?
investigations.objective: Do the vent, pore, and membrane regimes share a simultaneous operating window, or only a transport-connected sequence of microenvironments?
investigations.claim: The downstream pore-enrichment + membrane-retention machinery can rescue og-precursor-pool's nanomolar functional pool to a consumable (~uM) concentration, but only in a narrow corner at the upper edge of defensible small-molecule thermophoresis (S_T ~1e-2/K ceiling + high thermal gradient + high DIC together; overlap volume ~0.11 of the defensible grid, 0.42 overall). The canonical mid-point does not clear it. The rescue hinges on the Soret coefficient of the C2-C3 precursors (the dominant parameter by Morris), so measuring S_T(C2-C3) at the vent gradient is the discriminating experiment.
baseline_names: Operating window — canonical (the precursor pool, real pore + real membrane, defensible mid Soret)
Transport-decoupled null — membrane off (no retention)

investigations.name: og-precursor-pool
investigations.title: Precursor Pool: Can Vent Chemistry Build a Functional Pool?
investigations.objective: Does the vent's reduced-carbon chemistry deliver a functional precursor pool (not just bulk organic flux) that the reaction-network and amphiphile studies can consume?
investigations.claim: The vent's reduced-carbon chemistry delivers a de-novo, atom-balanced, budget-closed functional precursor pool whose controls all collapse it - but within the defensible DIC window the functional C2+ precursors are thermodynamically bounded to sub-micromolar, orders below what downstream chemistry can consume. Qualified.
baseline_names: Functional precursor pool — canonical, calibrated vent feed (DIC window)
Control — no H2 (reductant removed); the functional pool collapses
Control — no catalyst (mineral + base sites = 0); the pool collapses
Control — no gradient (no sustained vent resupply, k_feed = 0); the pool collapses

investigations.name: og-reproduction
investigations.title: Reproduction: Can Growth and Division Build a Lineage?
investigations.objective: How does a self-maintaining protocell reproduce — does metabolism drive growth to a measured-geometry division with viable daughters (not lysis or starvation), building a multi-generation lineage, each against its own matched null with input fluxes held equal?
investigations.claim: A self-maintaining protocell reproduces by metabolism-coupled growth and division into a lineage. Metabolism drives growth to a division at measured geometry with viable daughters, beating a null where growth is decoupled from metabolism or division is imposed (og-33, qualified); net throughput grows the compartment to division rather than lysis or starvation, mass-conserved, where a no-throughput ablation does not (og-growth-division, supported); and a growing, dividing individual builds a >=3-generation lineage with volume conserved across division (og-growth-alt, supported). Headline verdict qualified (coarse-grained geometry/budget abstraction); every matched null and every arm verdict preserved.
baseline_names: Chemically coupled growth and division — canonical arm (og-33)
Growth->division fate (vs no-throughput ablation) — og-growth-division arm
Physical reproduction to a multi-generation lineage — og-growth-alt arm

investigations.name: og-self-compartmentation
investigations.title: Self-Compartmentation: Does Metabolism Build Its Own Boundary?
investigations.objective: How does a vent-born chemical system acquire a self-made boundary and become a self-maintaining protocell — do amphiphiles assemble a retaining-but-not-isolating boundary, does encapsulation pay against a matched equal-feed null, does the integrated compartment self-maintain and beat a matched ablation, and are real fatty-acid vesicles stable — each against its own matched null with input fluxes held equal?
investigations.claim: A vent-born system acquires a self-made boundary and self-maintains as a protocell, the membrane buying persistence rather than raw throughput. Mixed fatty-acid/alcohol amphiphiles assemble into protocell boundaries in a vent window, giving individuality (retention) without full isolation and beating single-amphiphile controls (og-04, supported); a boundary also forms endogenously from the system's own carbon chemistry with a closed matter ledger (og-04-alt, supported); protometabolism-produced encapsulation pays against a matched equal-feed null on persistence and an access window but not on throughput, and the benefit is windowed (og-31, qualified); the integrated compartment self-maintains its membrane integrity and beats a matched ablation with MD-informed permeability (og-32, canonical, qualified); and real fatty-acid Martini-3 vesicles are stable across C10-C16 while a fully-charged null micellises at the short+charged corner, replacing og-32's phospholipid stand-in with a real amphiphile (og-32b, qualified — a short-MD fixed-charge stability trend, with the titratable/PMF gold standard tracked as og-32a). Headline verdict qualified. Every matched null and arm verdict is preserved.
baseline_names: First self-maintaining protocell (integrated, MD-informed) — canonical keystone arm (og-32)
Gate-C membrane benefit vs matched equal-feed null — og-31 arm
Mixed-amphiphile boundary assembly — og-04 foundation arm
Endogenous boundary from the system's own chemistry — og-04-alt arm
Real fatty-acid vesicle Martini MD (protonated vs charged null) — og-32b live-MD arm

investigations.name: og-self-maintaining-individual
investigations.title: Self-Maintaining Individuality: Does the Chemistry–Boundary Loop Close?
investigations.objective: Does the coupled chemistry-and-boundary system maintain itself - chemistry making the boundary that in turn sustains the chemistry - under perturbation, without a built-in production or retention gain?
investigations.claim: The coupled chemistry-and-boundary system does not maintain itself endogenously under defensible vent conditions: the chemistry's acetate (even at og-operating-window's favorable corner) yields an amphiphile pool ~4 orders below its CAC at the corner and ~7 orders below at the canonical point, so no membrane forms without assuming it, and reciprocal maintenance fails to close without a built-in retention gain - across all three ablations. A scoped refutation of endogenous closure; the broader individuality-emergence question stays open (§9).
baseline_names: Self-maintaining individual — canonical reciprocal loop (the precursor pool, real synthesis, aggregation-gated membrane)

investigations.name: og-spatial-concentration
investigations.title: Spatial Concentration: Does a Pore Enrich a Dilute Feed?
investigations.objective: Does a serpentinite pore concentrate a dilute vent feed above the dilution/retention threshold, and does the chemically-necessary multi-solute set co-localize or fractionate?
investigations.claim: A serpentinite pore concentrates a dilute vent feed above the dilution/retention threshold (Baaske regime cleared, accumulation Peclet 18.4) while an open-pore control washes through; but the chemically-necessary eight-solute set fractionates (Soret-driven, co-localization index ~0.18) rather than co-localizing — a candidate spatial incompatibility. Supported, bounded.
baseline_names: Thermophoretic concentration physics (og-03 arm)

investigations.name: og-vent-environment
investigations.title: The Vent Environment: Does It Supply a Viable Feed?
investigations.objective: Does a serpentinizing alkaline vent hold its empirical (Lost City) window across the operating grid and supply, in a calibrated posterior, the feed downstream chemistry needs?
investigations.claim: A serpentinizing alkaline vent holds its Lost City window (T 40-91 C, pH 9.0-10.8, positive H2 flux) over ~80% of the swept grid with |charge|=0, and conditioning on that window leaves a posterior 12.5% of the prior in which 100% of empirically supported vent states supply what downstream carbon fixation needs — transport-class-independent, ledger 0/96 rejected. Supported, bounded.
baseline_names: Serpentinizing vent reactor baseline (og-00 arm)
Geochemical world at the vent-calibration operating point (og-cal arm)

investigations.name: og-vent-interface
investigations.title: The Mineral Interface: Does It Sustain Flux Within a DIC Window?
investigations.objective: Does the evolving mineral-water interface sustain its H2 / inorganic-carbon flux and pH/redox gradient as minerals evolve, and where does the DIC window bound it?
investigations.claim: The evolving mineral interface delivers reduced-carbon chemistry only within a bounded two-regime DIC window — under full redox equilibrium, DIC is drawn down before free H2 appears, so the usable window is narrow (og27-dic-crossover-bounded-window; dic-crossover-sweep passes). Qualified: this DIC-cliff is the realized result; sustained-flux, mineral-evolution supply decay and the coupled ledger over timescales are scaffolded (planned), not yet run.
baseline_names: Coupled geochemical reaction interface — canonical (og-27)

investigations.name: og-vent-specificity
investigations.title: Vent Specificity: Are the Gates Vent-Specific or Generic?
investigations.objective: Do the campaign's discriminating gates detect the serpentinizing alkaline vent specifically, or would any generic non-equilibrium drive pass them?
investigations.claim: A generic drive stripped of ALL THREE vent features at once (no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalyst, no pore concentration) fails all five discriminating gates on the same real og-01/02/03 composites while the vent passes each — so the campaign's gates are NOT merely generic non-equilibrium detectors; the generic-nonequilibrium null is refuted by every gate (og-adv, canonical; verdict=refuted = null correctly rejected, gate_status=passed = the control discriminates). This is a LUMPED, all-feature-ablated contrast: it does not attribute the rejection to any single feature, and full vent-specificity — against competing realistic alternative environments — is NOT yet demonstrated (the H2 × Fe/Ni/S × pore-gradient 3-way factorial and the competing-environments study are planned, not run). Consolidated: specificity is demonstrated against a feature-ablated null, not yet against competing origin environments. Every matched null and arm verdict kept.
baseline_names: Generic non-vent adversarial control (ablated: no sustained H2 / no Fe-Ni-S catalyst / no pore) — canonical (og-adv), fails all five gates
Vent reference (characteristic features present) — passes all five gates
